meta.name: WordDrill
meta.note: 词库由 FlowUs 生词页同步而来；新增单词请用 scripts/sync-from-flowus.py 或直接编辑本文件。

words.example: There was an abundance of food at the party.

words.meaning: 诱惑力，魅力；v. 诱惑，吸引
words.example: The allure of the big city draws in young graduates every year.
words.exampleZh: 大城市的魅力每年都吸引着年轻毕业生。

words.example: At the end of this chapter there is a select bibliography of useful books.
words.exampleZh: 本章末尾附着有用书籍的精选书目。

words.meaning: 平常的，普通的；n. 老生常谈
words.example: Smartphones have become commonplace in daily life.
words.exampleZh: 智能手机在日常生活中已变得司空见惯。

words.meaning: 变形；歪曲，曲解；扭曲，使变形
words.example: Tall buildings can distort radio signals.
words.exampleZh: 高大的建筑物会使无线电信号失真。

words.meaning: 涉足，初步尝试（make forays into）；（短暂）突袭
words.example: The company made its first foray into the electric-vehicle market.
words.exampleZh: 该公司首次涉足电动车市场。

words.meaning: 概括， 归纳， 推断； 普及
words.example: Critics love to generalize, to formulate trends into which all new work must be fitted, however contradictory.
words.exampleZh: 评论家喜欢概括，归纳出所有新作品都必须符合的趋势，不管它们是如何地不符。

words.example: ...instructional material designed to help you with your lifestyle.
words.exampleZh: ...旨在为你的生活方式提供帮助的指导材料。

words.example: Tokyo is one of the largest metropolises in the world.
words.exampleZh: 东京是世界上最大的大都市之一。

words.meaning: 周期的； 定期的； 时而发生的；期刊
words.example: She made periodical visits to her dentist.
The report says climate change could also increase the prevalence of dengue fever.
words.exampleZh: 报告表示，气候变化还有可能增加登革热的流行强度。

words.example: ...the advantages of quantitative and qualitative research.
She remained resolute in her decision to study industrial design.
words.exampleZh: 她坚持学工业设计的决定毫不动摇。

words.example: He wiped the rim of the glass before pouring the wine.
The government took measures to shore up the weakening economy.
words.exampleZh: 政府采取措施支撑走弱的经济。

words.example: The company will unveil its new concept car next month.
words.exampleZh: 该公司下月将发布新款概念车。
